command.alias: Give a line a name of its own
command.chown: Change the owner and the group
command.cut: Print chosen columns of each line
command.df: Show how much room is left on the filesystems
command.diff: Show what changed between two files
command.du: Show how much space files take
command.export: Put a variable into the environment of child commands

command.free: Show how much memory is free
command.head: Print the first lines of a file
command.history: List the lines the shell has run

command.top: Watch the processes in a live list
command.touch: Create an empty file, or update its timestamp

git.status: Show what is changed and staged
